From bf32bceedd0453c70d9d022e2e29f98e446d7161 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Date: Thu, 28 Mar 2024 13:28:56 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] Input: ims-pcu - fix printf string overflow

clang warns about a string overflow in this driver

drivers/input/misc/ims-pcu.c:1802:2: error: 'snprintf' will always be truncated; specified size is 10, but format string expands to at least 12 [-Werror,-Wformat-truncation]
drivers/input/misc/ims-pcu.c:1814:2: error: 'snprintf' will always be truncated; specified size is 10, but format string expands to at least 12 [-Werror,-Wformat-truncation]

Make the buffer a little longer to ensure it always fits.

Fixes: 628329d52474 ("Input: add IMS Passenger Control Unit driver")
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240326223825.4084412-7-arnd@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Torokhov <dmitry.torokhov@gmail.com>

diff --git a/drivers/input/misc/ims-pcu.c b/drivers/input/misc/ims-pcu.c
index 6e8cc28debd9..80d16c92a08b 100644
--- a/drivers/input/misc/ims-pcu.c
+++ b/drivers/input/misc/ims-pcu.c
@@ -42,8 +42,8 @@ struct ims_pcu_backlight {
 #define IMS_PCU_PART_NUMBER_LEN		15
 #define IMS_PCU_SERIAL_NUMBER_LEN	8
 #define IMS_PCU_DOM_LEN			8
-#define IMS_PCU_FW_VERSION_LEN		(9 + 1)
-#define IMS_PCU_BL_VERSION_LEN		(9 + 1)
+#define IMS_PCU_FW_VERSION_LEN		16
+#define IMS_PCU_BL_VERSION_LEN		16
 #define IMS_PCU_BL_RESET_REASON_LEN	(2 + 1)
 
 #define IMS_PCU_PCU_B_DEVICE_ID		5
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/input/misc/ims-pcu.c`**
- The definitions for `IMS_PCU_FW_VERSION_LEN` and `IMS_PCU_BL_VERSION_LEN` have been changed from `(9 + 1)` to `16`. This increases the buffer size allocated for firmware and backlight version strings to ensure that they can accommodate the required data without causing a string overflow.

### Relationships
The modifications in the `ims-pcu.c` file address a warning from the Clang compiler regarding potential string overflow in the `snprintf` function calls. By increasing the buffer sizes for the firmware and backlight version strings, the patch ensures that the formatted output will fit within the allocated space, thus preventing truncation and potential bugs related to string handling. This change is directly related to the warnings mentioned in the patch description, which indicated that the previous buffer sizes were insufficient.

Here is the commit message:
Input: ims-pcu - fix printf string overflow

clang warns about a string overflow in this driver

drivers/input/misc/ims-pcu.c:1802:2: error: 'snprintf' will always be truncated; specified size is 10, but format string expands to at least 12 [-Werror,-Wformat-truncation]
drivers/input/misc/ims-pcu.c:1814:2: error: 'snprintf' will always be truncated; specified size is 10, but format string expands to at least 12 [-Werror,-Wformat-truncation]

Make the buffer a little longer to ensure it always fits.

Fixes: 628329d52474 ("Input: add IMS Passenger Control Unit driver")
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240326223825.4084412-7-arnd@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Torokhov <dmitry.torokhov@gmail.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug is caused by insufficient buffer sizes for the firmware and backlight version strings, which leads to potential string overflow when using `snprintf`. The original buffer sizes were too small to accommodate the formatted output, resulting in warnings about truncation during compilation.

Here is the patch:
 #define IMS_PCU_SERIAL_NUMBER_LEN	8
 #define IMS_PCU_DOM_LEN			8
-#define IMS_PCU_FW_VERSION_LEN		(9 + 1)
-#define IMS_PCU_BL_VERSION_LEN		(9 + 1)
+#define IMS_PCU_FW_VERSION_LEN		16
+#define IMS_PCU_BL_VERSION_LEN		16
 #define IMS_PCU_BL_RESET_REASON_LEN	(2 + 1)

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
#define IMS_PCU_FW_VERSION_LEN		(9 + 1)
#define IMS_PCU_BL_VERSION_LEN		(9 + 1)
snprintf(buffer, IMS_PCU_FW_VERSION_LEN, "Firmware: %s", fw_version);
```
Reason:
The buffer sizes defined for the firmware and backlight version strings were insufficient (10 bytes), which is not enough to hold the formatted output that can expand to at least 12 bytes, leading to potential string overflow when using `snprintf`.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
#define IMS_PCU_FW_VERSION_LEN		16
#define IMS_PCU_BL_VERSION_LEN		16
```
Reason:
By increasing the buffer sizes to 16 bytes, the patch ensures that the buffers can accommodate the formatted output without truncation, thus preventing the string overflow issue.
